Organic mobile MAU — changepoint probes, round2

Changepoint range {0.8, 0.87} × changepoint prior scale {0.005, 0.01, 0.02} on the organic series with the India + Indonesia iOS-rate cap; October 2026 mobile lock otherwise, Iran 2026 bridged in training. Last organic actual the probes trained on, 2026-10-09: 46,986,901 (+6.9% YoY). Targets (the round-2 brief): seam step within ±1%, Dec→Dec slope in the +3%..+8% band. Meets both: none.

Reading of round 2 (stop here for Brendan's call)

No probe meets both targets. The six runs trace a frontier: the settings that close the seam are the ones that carry a 2027 slope above the band, and the ones inside the band open 2–3% low.
  • The correction itself. The cap removes 440,081 MAU on 2026-10-09 (India 396K, Indonesia 44K; 0.93% of world organic mobile MAU). The capped series' own YoY is +6.9% against +7.9% uncorrected. Both capped countries' forecasts stay near the capped level; the uncorrected history (grey) is what they no longer chase.
  • Changepoint range 0.80 (last changepoint ≈ 2025-08-13): seam −2.6% to −3.3%, Dec→Dec +3.8% to +4.7%. Inside the slope band, but the seam gap is the round-1 problem at two-thirds size — the trend is fixed before the 2026 rise and the fit sits under the last actuals. Prior scale barely matters here (0.005 ≈ 0.01; 0.02 opens 0.7 pt higher).
  • Changepoint range 0.87 (last changepoint ≈ 2026-01-08): prior scale 0.005 → seam −2.1%, Dec→Dec +6.1% (the closest to both targets on the grid); 0.01 → seam −0.3% (meets) but +10.9%; 0.02 → +1.0% and +13.1%. Between 0.005 and 0.01 the final segment switches from "mostly pre-2026 trend" to "the high spend period's slope".
  • Against round 1. At range 0.87 the cap plus the stiffer prior took 2027-12-15 from 55.0M (prior 0.035, uncorrected) to 54.4M (0.01) and 50.6M (0.005); the cap alone is ~0.44M of the level at the seam, the rest is stiffness. At the October lock (0.725) nothing changes the picture: it opens −4% and goes flat.
  • If a round 3 is wanted (not run): walk the frontier at range 0.87 with prior scale 0.0065 / 0.0075 / 0.0085, or hold 0.01 and try range 0.83 / 0.85. Either way the remaining choice is how much of the 2026 rise to carry into 2027, which is a judgement about the attribution bleed and the high spend period, not a fit statistic.

1. The data correction in force: iOS-rate cap, ID + IN from 2026-04-01

Provisional (Brendan 2026-10-15; may be rolled back on the marketing DS team's read — rollback is dropping --ios-rate-cap, see data-official/2027-glean-draft/organic_mau/ios_rate_cap/IOS_RATE_CAP.md). Organic Fenix MAU training rows in these countries are capped at the level they would reach by growing at the country's own Firefox iOS rate (trailing 28-day mean ratio); the positive excess is treated as paid and removed, nothing is added back. Evidence: data-official/2027-glean-draft/organic_mau/paid_organic_correlation.html (section D).
